1.english_reference: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house

traditions.WLC: וַ֠ יָּשָׁב יְהוֹשָׁפָ֨ט מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֧ה אֶל בֵּית֛ וֹ
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν Ἰωσαφὰτ βασιλεὺς Ἰούδα εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: Revérsus est autem Iósaphat rex Iuda in domum suam
traditions.KJV: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house

traditions.WLC: בְּ שָׁל֖וֹם לִֽ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: pacífice in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: in peace to Jerusalem .

2.english_reference: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him , and said to king Jehoshaphat ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצֵ֣א אֶל פָּנָ֗י ו יֵה֣וּא בֶן חֲנָ֘נִי֮ הַ חֹזֶה֒ וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֔ט
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς ἀπάντησιν αὐτοῦ Ἰοὺ ὁ τοῦ Ἁνανεὶ ὁ προφήτης καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Βασιλεὺς Ἰωσαφάτ ,
traditions.VUL: Cui occúrrit Iehu fílius Hánani videns , et ait ad eum :
traditions.KJV: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him , and said to king Jehoshaphat ,

2.english_reference: Shouldest thou help the ungodly , and love them that hate the LORD ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ לָ רָשָׁ֣ע לַ עְזֹ֔ר וּ לְ שֹׂנְאֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תֶּאֱהָ֑ב
traditions.LXX: εἰ ἁμαρτωλῷ σὺ βοηθεῖς ἢ μισουμένῳ ὑπὸ Κυρίου φιλιάζεις ;
traditions.VUL: Impio præbes auxílium , et his qui odérunt Dóminum amicítia iúngeris ,
traditions.KJV: Shouldest thou help the ungodly , and love them that hate the LORD ?

2.english_reference: therefore [ is ] wrath upon thee from before the LORD .

traditions.WLC: וּ בָ זֹאת֙ עָלֶ֣י ךָ קֶּ֔צֶף מִ לִּ פְנֵ֖י יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἐγένετο ἐπὶ σὲ ὀργὴ παρὰ Κυρίου ·
traditions.VUL: et idcírco iram quidem Dómini merebáris :
traditions.KJV: therefore [ is ] wrath upon thee from before the LORD .

3.english_reference: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee ,

traditions.WLC: אֲבָ֕ל דְּבָרִ֥ים טוֹבִ֖ים נִמְצְא֣וּ עִמָּ֑ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἀλλ᾽ ἢ λόγοι ἀγαθοὶ ηὑρέθησαν ἐν σοί ,
traditions.VUL: sed bona ópera invénta sunt in te ,
traditions.KJV: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee ,

3.english_reference: in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land ,

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי בִעַ֤רְתָּ הָ אֲשֵׁרוֹת֙ מִן הָ אָ֔רֶץ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐξῆρας τὰ ἄλση ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: eo quod abstúleris lucos de terra Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land ,

3.english_reference: and hast prepared thine heart to seek God .

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲכִינ֥וֹתָ לְבָבְ ךָ֖ לִ דְרֹ֥שׁ הָֽ אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατηύθυνας τὴν καρδίαν σου ἐκζητῆσαι τὸν κύριον .
traditions.VUL: et præparáveris cor tuum ut requíreres Dóminum Deum patrum tuórum .
traditions.KJV: and hast prepared thine heart to seek God .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֥שֶׁב יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατῴκησεν Ἰωσαφάτ ,
traditions.VUL: Habitávit ergo Iósaphat in Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem :

4.english_reference: and he went out again through the people from Beersheba to mount Ephraim ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֜שָׁב וַ יֵּצֵ֣א בָ עָ֗ם מִ בְּאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֨בַע֙ עַד הַ֣ר אֶפְרַ֔יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάλιν ἐξῆλθεν εἰς τὸν λαὸν ἀπὸ Βεηρσάβεε ἕως ὄρους Ἐφράιμ ,
traditions.VUL: rursúmque egréssus est ad pópulum de Bersabée usque ad montem Ephraim ,
traditions.KJV: and he went out again through the people from Beersheba to mount Ephraim ,

4.english_reference: and brought them back unto the LORD God of their fathers .

traditions.WLC: וַ יְשִׁיבֵ֕ ם אֶל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: ἐπέστρεψεν αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ Κύριον θεὸν τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: et revocávit eos ad Dóminum Deum patrum suórum .
traditions.KJV: and brought them back unto the LORD God of their fathers .

5.english_reference: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעֲמֵ֨ד שֹֽׁפְטִ֜ים בָּ אָ֗רֶץ בְּ כָל עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה הַ בְּצֻר֖וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέστησεν κριτὰς πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσιν Ἰούδα ταῖς ὀχυραῖς
traditions.VUL: Constituítque iúdices terræ in cunctis civitátibus Iuda munítis
traditions.KJV: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah ,

traditions.WLC: לְ עִ֥יר וָ עִֽיר
traditions.LXX: ἐν πόλει καὶ πόλει .
traditions.VUL: per síngula loca ,
traditions.KJV: city by city ,

6.english_reference: And said to the judges , Take heed what ye do :

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל הַ שֹּֽׁפְטִ֗ים רְאוּ֙ מָֽה אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς κριταῖς Ἴδετε τί ὑμεῖς ποιεῖτε ,
traditions.VUL: et præcípiens iudícibus , Vidéte , ait , quid faciátis :
traditions.KJV: And said to the judges , Take heed what ye do :

6.english_reference: for ye judge not for man , but for the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י לֹ֧א לְ אָדָ֛ם תִּשְׁפְּט֖וּ כִּ֣י לַ יהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἀνθρώπῳ ὑμεῖς κρίνετε ἀλλ᾽ ἤ τῷ κυρίῳ ,
traditions.VUL: non enim hóminis exercétis iudícium , sed Dómini :
traditions.KJV: for ye judge not for man , but for the LORD ,

6.english_reference: who [ is ] with you in the judgment .

traditions.WLC: וְ עִמָּ כֶ֖ם בִּ דְבַ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט
traditions.LXX: καὶ μεθ᾽ ὑμῶν λόγοι τῆς κρίσεως .
traditions.VUL: et quodcúmque iudicavéritis , in vos redundábit .
traditions.KJV: who [ is ] with you in the judgment .

7.english_reference: Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you ;

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֕ה יְהִ֥י פַֽחַד יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν γενέσθω φόβος Κυρίου ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς ·
traditions.VUL: Sit timor Dómini vobíscum ,
traditions.KJV: Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you ;

traditions.WLC: שִׁמְר֣וּ וַ עֲשׂ֔וּ
traditions.LXX: φυλάσσετε καὶ ποιήσετε ,
traditions.VUL: et cum diligéntia cuncta fácite :
traditions.KJV: take heed and do [ it ] :

7.english_reference: for [ there is ] no iniquity with the LORD our God , nor respect of persons , nor taking of gifts .

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי אֵ֞ין עִם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗י נוּ עַוְלָ֛ה וּ מַשֹּׂ֥א פָנִ֖ים וּ מִקַּח שֹֽׁחַד
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν μετὰ Κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἀδικία οὐδὲ θαυμάσαι πρόσωπον οὐδὲ λαβεῖν δῶρα .
traditions.VUL: non est enim apud Dóminum Deum nostrum iníquitas , nec personárum accéptio , nec cupído múnerum .
traditions.KJV: for [ there is ] no iniquity with the LORD our God , nor respect of persons , nor taking of gifts .

8.english_reference: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set

traditions.WLC: וְ גַ֣ם בִּ֠ ירוּשָׁלִַם הֶעֱמִ֨יד יְהוֹשָׁפָ֜ט
traditions.LXX: καὶ γὰρ ἐν Ἰεπουσαλὴμ κατέστησεν Ἰωσαφὰτ
traditions.VUL: In Ierúsalem quoque constítuit Iósaphat
traditions.KJV: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set

8.english_reference: of the Levites , and [ of ] the priests ,

traditions.WLC: מִן הַ לְוִיִּ֣ם וְ הַ כֹּהֲנִ֗ים
traditions.LXX: τῶν ἱερέων καὶ τῶν Λευειτῶν
traditions.VUL: Levítas , et sacerdótes ,
traditions.KJV: of the Levites , and [ of ] the priests ,

8.english_reference: and of the chief of the fathers of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: וּ מֵ רָאשֵׁ֤י הָ אָבוֹת֙ לְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ τῶν πατριαρχῶν Ἰσραὴλ
traditions.VUL: et príncipes familiárum ex Israel ,
traditions.KJV: and of the chief of the fathers of Israel ,

8.english_reference: for the judgment of the LORD , and for controversies ,

traditions.WLC: לְ מִשְׁפַּ֥ט יְהוָ֖ה וְ לָ רִ֑יב
traditions.LXX: εἰς κρίσιν Κυρίου καὶ κρίνειν
traditions.VUL: ut iudícium et causam Dómini iudicárent
traditions.KJV: for the judgment of the LORD , and for controversies ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּשֻׁ֖בוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: habitatóribus eius .
traditions.KJV: when they returned to Jerusalem .

traditions.WLC: וַ יְצַ֥ו עֲלֵי הֶ֖ם לֵ אמֹ֑ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνετείλατο πρὸς αὐτοὺς λέγων
traditions.VUL: Præcepítque eis , dicens :
traditions.KJV: And he charged them , saying ,

9.english_reference: Thus shall ye do in the fear of the LORD , faithfully , and with a perfect heart .

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֤ה תַעֲשׂוּ ן֙ בְּ יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה בֶּ אֱמוּנָ֖ה וּ בְ לֵבָ֥ב שָׁלֵֽם
traditions.LXX: Οὕτως ποιήσετε ἐν φόβῳ Κυρίου , ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ ἐν πλήρει καρδίᾳ ·
traditions.VUL: Sic agétis in timóre Dómini fidéliter et corde perfécto .
traditions.KJV: Thus shall ye do in the fear of the LORD , faithfully , and with a perfect heart .

10.english_reference: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities , between blood and blood , between law and commandment , statutes and judgments ,

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל רִיב֩ אֲשֶׁר יָב֨וֹא עֲלֵי כֶ֜ם מֵ אֲחֵי כֶ֣ם הַ יֹּשְׁבִ֣ים בְּ עָרֵי הֶ֗ם בֵּֽין דָּ֣ם לְ דָם֮ בֵּין תּוֹרָ֣ה לְ מִצְוָה֮ לְ חֻקִּ֣ים וּ לְ מִשְׁפָּטִים֒
traditions.LXX: πᾶς ἀνὴρ κρίσιν τὴν ἐλθοῦσαν ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἡμῶν τῶν κατοικούντων ἀνὰ μέσον αἵματος , καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον προστάγματος καὶ ἐντολῆς , καὶ δικαιώματα καὶ κρίματα ·
traditions.VUL: Omnem causam , quæ vénerit ad vos fratrum vestrórum , qui hábitant in úrbibus suis inter cognatiónem et cognatiónem , ubicúmque quǽstio est de lege , de mandáto , de cæremóniis , de iustificatiónibus :
traditions.KJV: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities , between blood and blood , between law and commandment , statutes and judgments ,

10.english_reference: ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הִזְהַרְתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔ ם וְ לֹ֤א יֶאְשְׁמוּ֙ לַ יהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ διαστελεῖσθε αὐτοῖς , οὐχ ἁμαρτήσονται τῷ κυρίῳ ,
traditions.VUL: osténdite eis , ut non peccent in Dóminum ,
traditions.KJV: ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the LORD ,

10.english_reference: and [ so ] wrath come upon you , and upon your brethren :

traditions.WLC: וְ הָֽיָה קֶ֥צֶף עֲלֵי כֶ֖ם וְ עַל אֲחֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς ὀργὴ καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὑμῶν ·
traditions.VUL: et ne véniat ira super vos et super fratres vestros :
traditions.KJV: and [ so ] wrath come upon you , and upon your brethren :

10.english_reference: this do , and ye shall not trespass .

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֥ה תַעֲשׂ֖וּ ן וְ לֹ֥א תֶאְשָֽׁמוּ
traditions.LXX: οὕτως ποιήσετε , οὐχ ἁμαρτήσεσθε .
traditions.VUL: sic ergo agéntes non peccábitis .
traditions.KJV: this do , and ye shall not trespass .

11.english_reference: And , behold , Amariah the chief priest [ is ] over you in all matters of the LORD ;

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנֵּ֡ה אֲמַרְיָ֣הוּ כֹהֵן֩ הָ רֹ֨אשׁ עֲלֵי כֶ֜ם לְ כֹ֣ל דְּבַר יְהוָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἰδοὺ Ἀμαρίας ὁ ἱερεὺς ἡγούμενος ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς εἰς πᾶν λόγον Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: Amarías autem sacérdos et póntifex vester , in his , quæ ad Deum pértinent , præsidébit :
traditions.KJV: And , behold , Amariah the chief priest [ is ] over you in all matters of the LORD ;

11.english_reference: and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael , the ruler of the house of Judah , for all the king ’s matters :

traditions.WLC: וּ זְבַדְיָ֨הוּ בֶן יִשְׁמָעֵ֜אל הַ נָּגִ֤יד לְ בֵית יְהוּדָה֙ לְ כֹ֣ל דְּבַר הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ζαβδείας ὁ ἡγούμενος εἰς οἶκον Ἰούδα πρὸς πᾶν λόγον βασιλέως ,
traditions.VUL: porro Zabadías fílius Ismahel , qui est dux in domo Iuda , super ea ópera erit , quæ ad regis offícium pértinent :
traditions.KJV: and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael , the ruler of the house of Judah , for all the king ’s matters :

11.english_reference: also the Levites [ shall be ] officers before you .

traditions.WLC: וְ שֹׁטְרִ֥ים הַ לְוִיִּ֖ם לִ פְנֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται πρὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν ·
traditions.VUL: habetísque magístros Levítas coram vobis ,
traditions.KJV: also the Levites [ shall be ] officers before you .

traditions.WLC: חִזְק֣וּ וַ עֲשׂ֔וּ
traditions.LXX: ἰσχύσατε καὶ ποιήσατε ,
traditions.VUL: confortámini , et ágite diligénter ,
traditions.KJV: Deal courageously ,

11.english_reference: and the LORD shall be with the good .

traditions.WLC: וִ יהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִם הַ טּֽוֹב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται κύριος μετὰ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et erit Dóminus vobíscum in bonis .
traditions.KJV: and the LORD shall be with the good .
